user_query: Our company is interested in enhancing our telephone system with on hold audio messages. Can you guide us on how to use the On hold audio messages tool to order these messages? Additionally, check the account balance on eazita.com and provide us with the current balance.

TaskList.description: Research available On hold audio messages tools and their features.
Select the appropriate On hold audio messages tool based on the research.
Order On hold audio messages using the selected tool.
Check the account balance on eazita.com.
Provide the user with the current balance from eazita.com.
